appearances.title: TensorFold 1.2.4: 319K-token DeepSeek-V4.1 conversation restored from NVMe in about 1.3 s on two GB10s
appearances.summary: The local inference engine's new release restores a saved 319K-token DeepSeek-V4.1 session from disk in 1.2 to 1.4 s instead of 155 to 178 s on two GB10 (DGX Spark class) boxes, and cuts a two-client Flash Next MLX test on M5 Ultra from 127 s to 47 s. It also adds Gemma 4 E4B on CUDA, LFM3-1.7B on Metal, and HIP builds on Windows; a separate preview shows Qwen 3.8 27B NVFP4 at about 220 tok/s deco

appearances.title: TensorFold runs on Apple M1 GPUs under Linux via a Vulkan backend, 41% faster per token
appearances.summary: A contributor got TensorFold inference running on an M1 Max GPU under Linux through a Vulkan backend, cutting per-token latency from 160 ms to 94 ms with byte-identical output. The work is an in-progress PR, not yet merged.
